OpenAiIntegration.title: OpenAI
OpenAiIntegration.help: Optional AI enhancement for nuanced profiles, shortlist reranking and concise explanations.

luna.label: Recommended — GPT-5.6 Luna
luna.description: Best balance for nuanced taste analysis and recommendation ranking. Reasoning is disabled to control cost.

nano.label: Lowest cost — GPT-5 Nano
nano.description: Good for basic profiles and ranking, but explanations may be less nuanced.

fourOMini.label: Economical legacy — GPT-4o Mini
fourOMini.description: A proven, inexpensive choice for structured tasks and existing OpenAI setups.

fiveMini.label: Higher quality — GPT-5 Mini
fiveMini.description: Stronger reasoning for subtle preferences, with higher output costs.

custom.label: Custom model
custom.description: Use another OpenAI model ID. Cost estimates are unavailable for custom models.

modes.off: AI is not called. Recommendations use only Cued's deterministic scoring, so there is no API cost.
modes.conservative: AI reviews the top 8 candidates and contributes 15% of their final ranking. This keeps results close to Cued's deterministic score and uses the fewest AI tokens.
modes.balanced: AI reviews the top 12 candidates and contributes 25% of their final ranking. This is the recommended compromise between nuanced personalization, predictable results and API usage.
modes.enhanced: AI reviews the top 20 candidates and contributes 35% of their final ranking. It can reshape the list more noticeably and discover subtler matches, but uses more API tokens.

AiRefreshDelay.title: Refresh after taste changes
AiRefreshDelay.help: Wait for a quiet period after ratings or recommendation feedback, then update the AI profile and recommendations once. Each new change resets the timer; manual refreshes always run immediately.

AiActualUsage.title: Actual recorded usage
AiActualUsage.help: Cumulative successful profile and reranking usage recorded by Cued. OpenRouter supplies the actual cost; direct OpenAI cost is calculated from the selected preset price.

free.label: Free / automatic — compatible free model
free.description: OpenRouter selects an available free model that supports Cued's strict schema. Quality, latency and availability can vary; zero-data-retention routing remains mandatory.

glm52Free.label: Free / fixed — GLM 5.2
glm52Free.description: A capable fixed free model for consistent behavior. Free endpoint capacity and availability may still vary.

nemotron3SuperFree.label: Free / fixed — Nemotron 3 Super
nemotron3SuperFree.description: A large fixed free alternative with structured output support. Free endpoints can be slower or rate-limited.

glm53Flash.label: Recommended value — GLM 5.3 Flash
glm53Flash.description: Strong structured reasoning at very low cost. Cued uses low reasoning effort to keep latency and output usage controlled.

qwen38Flash.label: Strong economical — Qwen 3.8 Flash
qwen38Flash.description: A fast, capable multilingual alternative with a large context window and predictable structured output.

luna.label: Reliable balanced — GPT-5.6 Luna
luna.description: A reliable general-purpose choice when consistency matters more than the lowest possible price.

openRouterFourOMini.label: Economical legacy — GPT-4o Mini
openRouterFourOMini.description: A proven economical model retained for compatibility, but no longer the primary recommendation.
